podcast.title: Shoegaze Sound Wall and Doom Density
podcast.body: Doomgaze is a subgenre that blends the massive, layered "sound wall" aesthetic typical of shoegaze with the oppressive density of Doom Metal. This combination results in a dense, atmospheric sound that maintains the heavy characteristics of Doom while incorporating the textural and often ethereal elements of shoegaze. "...hasta el Doom Gaze que combina el muro de sonido terio del showgaze con la densidad oppresiva del Doom."
